title: Avian Migration Corridors (Observe · Reduce Light · Protect Nodes)
steps: Aggregate observation data (citizen science + official datasets)
Generate seasonal corridor density maps (hex or grid)
Overlay night-light intensity (VIIRS) and identify high-risk nodes
Audit overlap with protected areas (WDPA or national databases)
Define and publish priority corridor nodes
Implement light-curfew or mitigation pilots at selected nodes
Monitor seasonal shifts and publish monthly corridor bulletin
qa: Reproduce density maps with documented script
Verify light overlays with raw satellite source
Confirm protected overlap with official boundary dataset
